none: PAS NLM-BD53F3: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian, Victory left issue of 364-378, possibly Trier mint, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: [--]N[---]PF[--]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left holding wreath. Reverse inscription: [SECURIT]AS REI [PVBLICAE]. In exergue: possibly TRS. Cliff Reeves kindly inspected this coin. Diameter: 18.5mm, Weight: 2.12gms, die axis: 6
